plugins.name: deskkit
plugins.description: Coding agents drift from a project's own conventions and lose track of where work stands between sessions. This plugin checks a desk's documents against its own rules and applies fixes, drives tasks through a document-gated work graph, and briefs a fresh session at cold start — over one MCP server, two operator agents, and a set of skills. Personalize via the desk profile and desk_config, never by editing shipped definitions.
